logFilter.description: Log filtering by module (file name). 'enable: false' bypasses the moduleFilter entirely. Mode: 'allow' (only listed) or 'deny' (exclude listed). NOTE: This filter is orthogonal to log_level (_config.yml). Setting enable=false does NOT lower log_level — VERBOSE logs still require log_level: 'VERBOSE' in _config.yml. Candidates: RuleManager, AbbreviationMatcher.
